name: Mei Li
bio:
Mei Li's journey into motorsport HR was somewhat unconventional, starting with a degree in psychology and a brief stint in corporate recruitment. Her passion for racing ignited during a visit to the Shanghai Grand Prix, and she quickly realized her skills could be invaluable in the high-pressure environment of motorsport teams. She thrives on identifying and nurturing talent, ensuring the right people are in the right roles to drive performance on and off the track.

Mei approaches HR with a data-driven mindset, believing that objective analysis of skills and personality is crucial for building a successful team. She is known for her rigorous interview process and her commitment to fostering a positive and inclusive work environment, even within the demanding world of motorsport. Her ability to balance team morale with the relentless pursuit of excellence makes her a valuable asset to PEX Motorsport. She is particularly skilled at conflict resolution and performance management, ensuring that all team members are aligned with the team's strategic objectives.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle highlights
physical.description: Mei has a serious, yet approachable demeanor with a focus on her work.

quirks: Insists on starting every meeting exactly on time.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on her desk, each representing a different driver she's worked with.
